summary: The commenter, founder of a tokenization company who writes in a personal capacity and discloses a related product interest, supports ledger-based master securityholder files under transfer-agent control. The letter argues that the register records who holds a security but not whether what was issued matches what was described. It asks the Commission to consider a sourced, dated and versioned issuance record that the master securityholder file can reference, and not to read 'exclusive control' as excluding public networks when restrictions, freeze and recovery powers, and documented reconciliation are in place. It also asks the Commission to weigh small-issuer costs when rescinding Rule 17ad-4. This is the commenter's position, not an SEC or TitleChain Foundation conclusion.
